title: Electron donor–acceptor complex-driven photocatalyst-free synthesis of nitrocyclopropanes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15155-15163
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02540K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Paula Pérez-Ramos, Patrícia I. C. Godinho, Raquel G. Soengas, Humberto Rodríguez-Solla
Herein, a visible light-promoted metal-free protocol for the synthesis of nitrocyclopropanes is reported, exploiting the photochemical activity of a ternary EDA complex.
